protocol.normalization: Train-only mean and std, each std floored at 1e-6
protocol.split: Whole reset seeds across all policy and noise copies; train fresh seeds except seed%8==2 (validation). Exclude 927001 entirely from train/validation. Test development seeds 927000..927015 only.
protocol.transition: First second after semantic held-key set changes, excluding initial idle

gate.bootstrap: 2000 paired reset-seed clusters, 95% percentile interval lower improvement > 0

protocol.scope: Information diagnostic in native target physics, not causal proof of policy improvement or final acceptance
protocol.validation: Fixed epoch 10/20/30/40 learning curves only; never choose endpoint by validation/test
